Deadlock hack modules Aimbot & Targeting Silent Aim (PSilent) : Locks and fires on targets without ever moving your visible crosshair, spoofing only the camera position. Normal Aimbot : Classic visible aimbot that smoothly pulls your aim onto the best target. Aimbot Activation Key : Bind a hold or toggle key that arms the aimbot only when you want it. Targeting Cone (FOV) : Sets the on-screen angle within which enemies can be acquired. Target Priority : Choose how the best target is picked: minimal FOV, closest, lowest/highest HP, threat, or random. Aim Smoothing & Humanization : Frame-independent smoothing with organic drift, inertia, reaction delay, curved flicks, and stickiness for a natural feel. Hitbox Selection : Per-bone control over which body zones (head, neck, torso, arms, legs) are targeted. Headshot Limiter : Caps your headshot percentage and shows a live headshot-rate indicator. Hit Chance & No Spread : Only fires when hit probability is high enough, with an optional spread-removal assist. Distance-Scaled FOV : Automatically tightens the aim cone as targets get farther away. FOV Circle Display : Draws and styles the aim cone as a screen circle or a world ring at target distance, with color, fill, and thickness controls. Off-Screen Target Indicators : Points to targets outside your view and shows target distance. Target Ignore Filters : Skips unstoppable, invisible, out-of-sight, or zipline-protected targets so you only lock what matters. Backtrack : Fires at a target's recent past position so the server's lag-compensation rewind lands the shot. Target Lock : Holds your aim on a single chosen target instead of switching. Combat & Abilities Soul Triggerbot : Automatically fires the instant a soul orb is on your crosshair, with range and delay tuning. Ability Aim Assist : Auto-aims skill-shot abilities at the best target within their own cast range and cone. Item Aim Assist : Auto-targets aimed items with dedicated cone, range, priority, and ignore rules. Counter Spell : Automatically counters incoming enemy abilities. Anti-Parry : Prevents your melee from being parried by the enemy. Melee Faker : Fakes a melee attack to bait and cancel, including item-cancel options. Heavy Melee Assist : Automates the charged heavy-melee swing. Auto Parry : Parries incoming melee threats including heavy, light, Guardian, and Viscous puddle punch, timed to impact. Auto Dodge : Reactively dodges incoming threats with an escape or down-dash and auto-counterspells. Auto Active Reload : Hits the active-reload timing window automatically. Visual ESP Enemy ESP : Reveals enemy players through walls with fully configurable overlays. Ally ESP : Shows the same rich overlays for teammates. Info Elements : Toggle name, health number, health bar, hero icon, ability cooldowns, skeleton, and distance per player. Box Styles : Draw players with 2D, corner, or 3D boxes. Snaplines & View Lines : Draw a line to each player and show their aim direction. State Color Overrides : Recolor players when invisible, unstoppable, or using an ultimate. NPC & Trooper ESP : Show enemy/friendly troopers and neutral NPCs with names, health, and boxes. Soul ESP : Highlights soul orbs in a custom color. Objective & Object ESP : Marks breakables, jungle camps, power-ups, and enemy deployables (Venator traps, Graves skulls, McGinnis turrets). Camp Respawn Timers : Countdown for cleared T1/T2/T3 camps and Sinner's Sacrifice, on the minimap or in-world with color gradient. Power-Up Alarm : Early-warning alerts before power-ups spawn. Threat Warnings : Talon bird locator, in-flight Bebop hook grab-range warning, and in-burrow indicator. Footstep & Sound ESP : Visualizes enemy footsteps in the world and off-screen with directional arrows. Minimap Unlock : Reveals the full minimap and overlays camp timers on it. ESP Text & Icons : Controls ESP text size, image size, font, and drop shadow. Chams & World Visuals Player Chams : Render enemies and allies with solid, wireframe, or custom material styles, even through walls. Custom Chams Material : Author your own KV3 chams material for visible and occluded states. Glow / Outline : Outline or fill players with an HP-tinted glow of adjustable width. Nightmode : Darkens the whole world without dimming the HUD, with tint color and strength. World Modulation : Tints world geometry with a custom color. Fog Control : Toggles and adjusts world fog density. Skybox Changer : Swap or disable the skybox and set a custom sky color. Custom Lighting : Recolor world lighting and particles. Ambient Particles : Adds soft glowing orbs drifting across the map. Anti-Blind (Drifter Ult) : Blocks the screen blind from Drifter's Darkness ultimate. Hero Scripts Hero Script Engine : The single driver that powers per-hero ability automation across the roster. Hero Automation Library (42 Heroes) : Ready-made per-hero scripts covering the full roster: Abrams, Apollo, Bebop, Billy, Calico, Celeste, Doorman, Drifter, Dynamo, Fathom, Graves, Grey Talon, Haze, Holliday, Infernus, Ivy, Kelvin, Lady Geist, Lash, McGinnis, Mina, Mirage, Mo & Krill, Paige, Paradox, Pocket, Raven, Rem, Seven, Shiv, Silver, Sinclair, Trapper, Venator, Victor, Vindicta, Viscous, Vyper, Warden, Wraith, Wrecker, Yamato. Ability Combos & Item Chains : One-key combos that chain a hero's abilities and items in the right order. Auto-Cast Charged Skill-Shots : Automatically charges and releases charged skill-shots at the ideal moment. Head-Lock Shots : Locks aimed hitscan shots to the head while an empowering buff is live (e.g. Venator crossbow, Holliday Crackshot). Auto-Snipe (Vindicta) : Dedicated auto-snipe assist for Vindicta's Assassinate. Can-Kill Badge : Marks every enemy you can currently execute with a customizable ult badge. Script Aim & Targeting : Dedicated aim mode, reach, smoothing, and headshot settings for script and ability casts, separate from the gun aimbot. Per-Hero Overrides : Give any hero its own aim, targeting, and ignore rules instead of the global defaults. Hero Script Visuals : Toggle a hero's script rings, target/kill markers, and indicators. Movement & Automation Auto Wall Bounce / Corner Boost : Automatically executes corner boosts, with a real-corners-only filter and wall visualizer. Bunny Hop : Auto-jumps to keep your momentum chained. Auto Strafe : Steers your air movement for optimal strafe speed. Auto Wall Jump : Fires wall jumps at the right moment automatically. Slow Walk : Scales movement down for silent, precise positioning. Auto Slide : Holds a slide whenever one is available. Auto Dash-Jump : Triggers the dash-jump inside the game's own dash-jump window. Zipline Momentum : Conserves zipline speed and controls eject velocity. Movement Recorder : Records and replays movement paths with an on-screen path preview. Auto-Steer Assist : Experimental auto-steering toward the best bounce line. Lua Scripting AvaLua Script Engine : In-house Lua host for running custom user scripts with hot-reload. Script Marketplace : Browse, publish, and download community scripts in-client. Code Editor & Console : Built-in script editor with IntelliSense and a live console. Rendering & Menu API : Draw, Render, shader, ImGui, and menu-building bindings for custom overlays and UI. Game & Entity API : Read entities, game state, schema, traces, and prediction from script. Aim & Combat API : Script access to the aim engine, combat, combos, backtrack, and hero config. Input & Events API : Bind input, callbacks, hooks, and timers. Networking & Storage API : HTTP, WebSocket, JSON, protobuf, file, memory, and persistent storage bindings. ESP & Particle API : Script-driven ESP elements and particle effects. Panorama & FFI API : Interact with the game's Panorama UI and call native functions directly. Misc & Utility Streamer Mode : Hides names, teams, avatars, match ID, and other identifying info for safe streaming. Spectator List : On-screen panel showing who is spectating you, with hero portraits. Bind Island : A panel listing your active binds, hotkeys, and running hero scripts. Headshot Meter : HUD readout of your headshot rate with recent-shot history. Override FOV : Sets a custom camera field-of-view angle. Preserve Killfeed : Keeps the killfeed showing your own kills and assists. Watchlist Monitor : Flags and tracks specific players across matches. Disable Ping-on-Invis : Stops the game from pinging you when invisible. HUD Scale & Opacity : Global size and transparency controls for every on-screen panel. Config & UI Menu Hotkeys : Bind the menu open/close toggle and an instant panic-hide key. Menu Scale & Accent : Set the menu window size and primary accent color. Menu Font : Choose the menu's body typeface from curated faces. Language / Localization : Switch the menu language across 12 supported languages. Menu Animations & Sound : Smooth transitions, animated snow background, and hover/click sound volume. Render Quality : Anti-aliased lines and fills, plus ESP text shadow tuning. Cloud Config Sync : Cloud-first saving and loading of your settings, no local files required. Config Profiles : Save, load, and reset complete configuration profiles. Keybind Manager : Central store for all feature keybinds.
